top_signals.title: Long Bonds Drop on Fed Pause, Nasdaq Futures Gain: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian bonds tracked Treasuries lower as uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook pushed longer-dated US yields to their highest levels in almost two decades. US stock futures rose as a recent chip-led selloff showed signs of easing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
